heading: INT. SPACE ELEVATOR COUNTERWEIGHT STATION - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. SPACE ELEVATOR COUNTERWEIGHT STATION - CONTINUOUS
A cylindrical chamber lined with frost-furred cable bundles.
Emergency strips pulse amber.
Through a cracked viewport, the curve of the Earth drops away, blue and silent.
CAPTAIN IRENE VASQUEZ-LU, 50s, close-cropped silver hair, hangs in a harness over a open maintenance panel.
BODE ADEYEMI, 30s, a stocky engineer, floats beside her with a spanner.
DR. SANJAY KUMARESAN, 40s, thin, wire glasses, clings to a rail and stares at a handheld readout.
TAVITA FONOTI, 22, a rookie in an oversized pressure suit, wedges himself into a corner.
Status.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: Tether strain at ninety-four percent. We're twelve minutes from shear.
units.name: BODE

units.text: Doctor?
units.name: IRENE

units.text: No. No, that's wrong. That cannot be wrong.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: Doctor Kumaresan.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: The oscillation isn't mechanical. It's rhythmic. It's... answering us.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: Answering what?
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: Our own vibrations. Something on the cable is repeating them back, delayed.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: Irene unclips her harness, kicks across the chamber, and grips the rail beside Sanjay.
She reads the numbers over his shoulder.
Bode drops the spanner, which drifts away unnoticed, and swims to the viewport.
That's impossible. There's no one out there.
units.name: BODE

units.text: Everybody, quiet. Listen.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: They go still.
The station groans.
Under it, faint and regular, three taps.
A pause.
Three taps.
It's coming from below the panel.
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: It's a cable creak.
units.name: BODE

units.text: It's not a creak, Bode.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: Hypothesis one, resonance. Hypothesis two, a micrometeorite impact pattern. Hypothesis three...
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: He trails off.
He does not say hypothesis three.
Captain, permission to open the panel?
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: Negative. Nobody touches it. Bode, can we cut the tether remotely?
units.name: IRENE

units.text: We cut it, the whole counterweight goes. Ten thousand tons falls to the ground.
units.name: BODE

units.text: Then we don't cut it.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: We don't have a lot of other options.
units.name: BODE

units.text: Three more taps.
Louder.
The panel rattles in its frame.
It's trying to get in.
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: It isn't trying to get in. It's trying to get our attention.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: Then it has it.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: She pushes off the rail, drifts to the panel, and presses her palm flat against the metal.
The taps stop.
A long silence.
Bode holds his breath.
Sanjay's readout flashes red and then goes blank.
Come on. Talk to me.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: From inside the panel, a single tap.
Then another, softer, as if from a hand pressing back.
Captain, don't.
units.name: BODE

units.text: Everyone, strap in. We're opening it.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: With respect, Captain, no.
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: Strap in, Tavita.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: Tavita obeys, fingers fumbling at the clasps.
Bode grabs the spanner from the air.
Sanjay seals his visor.
Please be a cable. Please be a cable.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: Irene fits the spanner to the first bolt.
It turns with a groan.
The second bolt turns.
The panel peels back a hand's width.
A cold blue light spills through the gap.
All four faces turn pale in it.
What is that?
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: Hold your positions.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: I'm holding.
units.name: BODE

units.text: Captain, the readout's back. It says we have forty minutes.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: It said twelve a minute ago.
units.name: IRENE

units.text: It says forty now. Something changed the number.
units.name: SANJAY

units.text: The blue light brightens.
The tapping resumes, slow and calm, like a heartbeat.
Then we don't have twelve minutes. We have as long as it wants.
units.name: IRENE
